reply:
rem is relative to root (html), em is relative to parent. That's the wrong unit for what you're trying to do.

If you want to double the parent font size, use `font-size: 2em` instead. With 2rem, the size depends on the root font-size—if the root is larger than the parent, 2rem will be much bigger than double the parent.
